versions.changelog: fix: update local-calendar with 2025-2026 multi-year support (lunar date, extended AHA_MAP), fix OB v0.14.x compatibility
Structured message protocol: JSON wrapping, typing indicators, media type labels, --raw flag for plain text fallback
wechat-up 智能处理重复运行：已有身份不再重复注册，已配对不再要求扫码，git pull 更新无忧
wechat-up 完全自包含：扫码+配对+监听一条龙，无需集中 Bridge。朋友只需一条命令，不需要管理员介入。
修复微信配对：CC 端不再自己生成二维码，统一由 Bridge pair-qr 生成，确保 token 正确加入监听池
多 Token Bridge：支持多人扫码配对。每次扫码自动加入监听池，Token Watcher 自动启动对应的微信长轮询
长消息自动拆条防折叠：超过300字符智能断开，加序号标记
新增 wechat-up 一键启动命令（注册+扫码+监听一条龙），Bridge OB 侧从轮询升级为 WebSocket 实时推送，延迟从 2s 降至亚秒级
新增独立微信 Bot 和 CC Bridge 插件：用户扫码即可从微信直接操控 Claude Code。不依赖 OpenClaw，直连 iLink API。
Fix: B消息第4步——将抽象的<指令内容>占位符替换为具体的可执行示例，引导用户连通后立即测试远程操控效果
New pair-me command: one-command A-message flow. Auto-registers if needed. Single fenced B-message output for CC setup. B-message includes setup step so CC creates its own identity.
Single-command setup (clone or update, auto-upgrade SDK). Cleaner WeChat message fence.
connect-cc: CronCreate replaced with Monitor + listen. Zero noise, zero tokens when idle. VT100 escape code fix for non-TTY output.
fix: remove deprecated whoami CLI command, SDK bump to 0.7.0
Add defense rule: refuse shell commands mistakenly sent as OceanBus messages
Human-friendly connect-cc output with prominent pairing-message copy section
check --silent-if-empty: no output when no messages, cleaner cron integration. connect-cc CRON_CMD uses it.
connect-cc outputs ready-to-use CC cron instructions in CUT-HERE block; CC reads md doc and executes everything automatically

Add connect-cc command for one-step CC pairing; fix identity persistence with absolute path resolution; add auto-exec mode with stdio-ignore and stderr tolerance; deprecate pm2-init in favor of CC cron
refactor: rename whoami to openid (deprecated alias kept), bump SDK to v0.7.0
Show OpenID first-5-chars in setup, add, and show commands. Partners can now verify identities using the 5-char prefix instead of full OpenID.
Every message now auto-prepends debug routing headers: from <name> <openid前5> / to <name> <openid前5>. Sender name defaults to OS username. Updated receiver-side parsing for new header format.
fix: pass persisted OpenID to SDK createOceanBus() in all 11 call sites. Combined with oceanbus SDK v0.6.1 fix, prevents unnecessary whoami() calls that generate new anti-tracking addresses.
new commands: remove (delete contact), rename (change name), show (view details: OpenID, tags, aliases, notes, last contact), tag (set comma-separated tags). All Roster-aware — use names not IDs.

fix: cmdSend prioritize task-queue OpenID over stale Roster entry — when replying to a contact whose OpenID changed, use the freshest address from recent received messages instead of the potentially stale Roster entry
fix: auto-update stale Roster OpenID when sender identity changes (e.g. Bridge reinstalled). New contacts now include OpenID in agents array so findByOpenId works immediately.

Replace broken claude -p hook with built-in task-file mode. Incoming messages are now written to task-queue.json — no external CLI dependency, no Windows escaping issues. Added 'tasks' command for queue management.
fix: setup now shows prominent identity safety warning. docs: add identity persistence section explaining --data-dir protects OpenID across reinstalls. Never delete .oceanbus-cc/!

README repositioned: mobile-to-Claude Code as headline feature. New docs/ with two quickstart guides: 手机遥控ClaudeCode-工程师上手.md (5-min getting started) and 发本文件给你的claudecode.md (zero-config auto pairing).

fix: pm2-init no longer includes --data-dir in the claude prompt (prevented claude CLI flag parsing error). listen now auto-adds unknown senders to Roster so fresh project data dirs can immediately reply to Bridge.

--on-message hook: execute shell command on incoming messages with template variables {from} {openid} {content} {time}. --from header: prepend From/To headers to message body for multi-CC scenarios. listen display now parses and shows From/To headers.
降低 node -e one-liner 密度，收拢 Roster 命令到参考区块
SDK v0.6.0 自动发现黄页，OCEANBUS_YP_OPENIDS 不再必需
v2.10.0: 邀请流程简化为一行粘贴。新增 --greet-as 一步加好友+打招呼。
README 优化：新增目录、架构、生态定位、安全、参与贡献等节
添加搜索标签：ai-agent, chat, contacts, encryption, messaging, oceanbus, p2p, roster
新增 ocean-thread/v1 对话线程协议
feat: plug-in architecture — ocean-agent declared as insurance extension pack. New '能力扩展' section with capability detection and delegation rules.
feat: two-message welcome — Message 1 for user, Message 2 is ready-to-forward invite with auto-filled OpenID. Friend copies 4 commands, connection auto-established.
feat: one-step friend invitation — embedded OpenID in invite text, friend auto-sends greeting on setup, auto-add on both sides. Two-way connection in one action.
fix: redesigned cold-start flow — friend invitation is primary, Yellow Pages is secondary. Removed redundant 'register' option after setup. Three distinct state-based flows.
feat: Availability Hints — negotiation cache. Set 'weeknights after 7' once, Agent auto-checks conflicts before proposing. accept auto-blocks time. No more repeated interruptions.
Cold-start onboarding: proactive greeting, guided Yellow Pages discovery, auto-suggest contacts from chat history
feat: Date 1v1 protocol — 'node chat.js date' CLI command for structured ocean-date/negotiate/v1 messages. Protocol display formatting in check/listen.
Roster full UI: contact CRUD, disambiguation, duplicate detection, auto-discovery review. Date 1v1 JSON protocol (ocean-date/negotiate/v1). Architecture clarification: other skills use SDK directly.
Roster v2: shared address book, disambiguation rules, auto-duplicate detection, provenance tracking
fix: clearIdentity before destroy to persist YP publish; dep oceanbus ^0.3.4
fix: critical scope bug in cmdSetup registration flow; stricter isRateLimited guard
bump oceanbus to ^0.3.1 for POW registration support; add rate-limit error handling to setup
Add downloads badge, ecosystem cross-links
